PDF to PowerPoint on Mac

Complete the pdf to powerpoint task in your Mac browser. These instructions cover selecting local files and finding the downloaded result.

Select PDF file
or drop PDF here
Files are processed in your browser; this tool does not upload the selected file for processing.
PDF up to 100MB · up to 200 selected pages
No account needed
How to complete this task
Select a PDF.
Review conversion quality and available text options.
Convert and download the presentation, then inspect the slides.
What to check for this task

Use the file picker to choose documents from Finder. Download cloud-only files before selecting them.

After downloading, open the file from your browser's Downloads list or the Downloads folder in Finder.

Compatibility

Keep the browser tab open while processing. Available memory limits large document jobs.

A modern browser with JavaScript enabled.

Large files depend on available device memory.

Processing and privacy

Files are processed in your browser; this tool does not upload the selected file for processing.

Limitations

Rendered pages are images; optional extracted text does not recreate original editable slide objects.

Questions about this task
How is my file processed?
Files are processed in your browser; this tool does not upload the selected file for processing.
What should I check before using the result?
Rendered pages are images; optional extracted text does not recreate original editable slide objects.
